_doc: R0 B.1 projectiles.json: ProjectileDef[] (owner 02). Values from 02 s4.2 table and R0 B.5 motion rule. Fields shown as '-' in 02 are omitted (default 0 / false / null). Projectile ids are a per-file namespace (R0 B.8 A-1); 'bomb' is both a weapon and a projectile. flak_shell fuse is timed (predicted intercept + 0.3 s, early burst within fuse_radius_m, 02 s4.2). supply_canister is candidate SL-5: its speed, lifetime and radius are not in 02 and its numbers live in 08 SL-5 (commander_verbs.json). Mesh paths per 07 s10 (proj_<id>).
